decision: Remove exact repeats and keep the first row.
reason: The registry re-export repeats identical patient records rather than recording additional patients.

issue: gender spellings that are not a code
decision: Strip and lowercase text, map known spellings to F/M/X, and leave blanks and unknown missing.
reason: Female/woman, male/man, and nonbinary/NB spellings identify the dictionary categories while unknown supplies no gender.

decision: Uppercase site codes and remove every space and hyphen.
reason: Spellings such as N-01 and n01 refer to N01, while E04 must remain a separate registry code even though the directory omits it.

decision: Replace 9999 with missing and use nullable Int64.
reason: The data dictionary defines 9999 as not recorded rather than a patient's birth year.

issue: weight column named wt_kg in visits_south.csv
decision: Rename wt_kg to weight_kg before stacking and preserve the exporting filename.
reason: Both offices report the same kilogram measurement, and the south export also serves E04 patients.

issue: sbp sentinel 999 and readings outside 70 through 250
decision: Convert SBP to numbers and retain only the inclusive 70 to 250 range as nullable Int64.
reason: 999 means not measured and other out-of-range entries violate the contract, while the planted 70 and 250 readings satisfy it.

issue: impossible and loosely written visit dates
decision: Require exact YYYY-MM-DD text and a real calendar date; otherwise store NaT.
reason: Dates such as 2026-02-30 are impossible and 2026/02/02 fails the required input format.

decision: Remove exact repeats, normalize visit labels, then retain the reading with the later visit_time.
reason: The remaining repeated pairs are same-visit rechecks taken 10 to 30 minutes later and should contribute one updated reading.

decision: Keep current records only and select site_code and site_name.
reason: N01 and S02 each have a retired name, so using all versions would multiply patient rows and attach obsolete names.
